feedback: The reward machine correctly encodes the conditional task (siren rings at some point) => (switch toggled at least once, before or after the ring), on top of reaching the exit. State structure u0/u1/u2/u3 tracks exactly the two task facts (siren-has-rung, has-toggled) with u4 as the success terminal; FINAL_STATES: u4 is present, declared in STATES, and every entry into u4 requires at_exit on a task-satisfying path (no-siren exit from u0, toggle-only exit from u2, both-facts exit from u3), so u4 is accepting precisely for successful episode ends. Ordered transition coverage is total and deterministic in every state: the four guarded u0 branches are pairwise disjoint and the residual at_exit cases route correctly (exit while siren ringing with no toggle falls to u1 via the siren_ringing branch, paying 0, which is the correct failure outcome). Persistent/event distinctions are handled right: siren_ringing is treated as a persistent condition (first truth moves u0->u1/u3, later truth absorbed by else), switch_toggled as a one-step trigger (u1->u3 fires even though the silencing toggle makes siren_ringing false on that step), and the same-step ring+toggle case (action applies before due events, so both labels hold) is covered by (u0, siren_ringing & switch_toggled) -> u3. The environment's impossible co-occurrences are respected: switch_toggled & at_exit never needs a branch, and in u2 the nominal overlap of (siren_ringing & !at_exit) with (at_exit) lies on siren_ringing & at_exit, which cannot occur since a ring cannot start on the episode-ending step and any earlier ring would already have left u2. Irrelevant propositions holding_box and box_fell are absorbed by per-state else self-loops in all five states. Rewards are safe and bounded (max 1.2 = 0.2 progress for completing the siren+toggle conjunction, entered from any of u0/u1/u2, plus 1.0 on u4 entry; no negative rewards, no farmable loops since u3/u4 self-loops pay 0 and at_exit occurs at most once). Giving 0 for the bare pre-siren toggle (u0->u2) and for the uncontrollable ring start (u0->u1) keeps shaping unbiased and is consistent. The task is monotone (no fact can be un-earned), so the absence of regressive transitions is correct; the second siren start and extra toggles are properly absorbed as no-ops in u3. All states are reachable and can reach u4 (u1 via toggle). Minor non-blocking notes: u1's else self-loop doubles as the implicit failure sink at exit/step-limit with reward 0 rather than an explicit fail state, and the 0.2 progress reward can land on the step-limit step (e.g., u1->u3), which is harmless shaping.
